product.title: Borghese Gallery Max 6 People Tour: Baroque & Renaissance in Rome

description.text: Explore a treasure trove of baroque and Renaissance art at Rome's Borghese Gallery—and discover insider facts you'd miss if visiting on your own—on this small-group tour. Housed in a 17th-century palazzo, the museum is home to world-class collection by Italian masters like Caravaggio, Bernini, Canova, and Raphael. Stops include Galleria Borghese, Piazzale del Museo Borghese. See many of the gallery’s most important paintings and sculptures while your guide shares stories about the artists and patrons behind them. Ideal for visitors basing in Rome who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Galleria Borghese, Piazzale del Museo Borghese that define this Rome sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
